<blog>

# My Shadow - Local AI Chat Application

## Project Introduction

My Shadow is a sophisticated mobile application that brings large language models (LLMs) and speech-to-text capabilities directly to mobile devices through a React Native/Expo architecture. The project enables users to engage in intelligent conversations with local AI models without requiring cloud connectivity, making it an excellent solution for privacy-conscious users who want to leverage cutting-edge AI capabilities on their smartphones.

### Purpose Statement
The application serves as a comprehensive local AI assistant that combines text generation, voice input/output, and model management capabilities, all running entirely on-device for maximum privacy and performance.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Privacy-First AI**: All AI processing occurs locally on the device, eliminating data transmission concerns
- **Multi-Modal Interaction**: Support for both text-based and voice interactions
- **Flexible Model Management**: Dynamic loading/unloading of various AI models optimized for different hardware configurations
- **Cross-Platform Compatibility**: Unified experience across iOS and Android platforms
- **Performance Optimization**: Intelligent memory management and GPU acceleration for optimal device performance

### Target Audience
- Privacy-conscious individuals seeking AI assistance without cloud dependency
- Developers interested in on-device AI implementations
- Users with limited internet connectivity requiring offline AI capabilities
- Educational institutions teaching AI concepts through practical examples

## Technical Architecture

The application follows a modular, feature-driven architecture built on React Native and Expo, utilizing modern state management and dependency injection patterns.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Root Layout] --> B[User Preferences Provider]
    B --> C[Navigation Stack]
    C --> D[Chat Screen]
    C --> E[History Screen]
    C --> F[Models Screen]
    
    D --> G[Chat View Model]
    G --> H[AI Runtime]
    G --> I[Conversation Manager]
    G --> J[Streaming Generator]
    
    H --> K[Llama Runtime]
    H --> L[Model Loader]
    
    I --> M[Chat Database]
    I --> N[Message Store]
    
    J --> O[Tool Registry]
    O --> P[Web Search Tool]
    O --> Q[URL Fetch Tool]
    
    F --> R[Model Catalog]
    F --> S[Download Manager]
    
    T[UI Components] --> U[Primitive Components]
    T --> V[Feature Components]
    T --> W[Custom UI Library]
```

### Component Breakdown

The architecture is organized into several key layers:

**Presentation Layer**: React Native components with custom UI primitives and feature-specific screens
**Domain Layer**: Business logic encapsulated in view models and managers
**Data Layer**: Local persistence using MMKV with LegendAppState observables
**Integration Layer**: External services including AI model downloads and tool execution

### Design Patterns

The application implements several key design patterns:

- **MVVM Pattern**: View models manage UI state and business logic
- **Repository Pattern**: Abstracts data access through managers and loaders
- **Observer Pattern**: Reactive state management using LegendAppState
- **Factory Pattern**: Dynamic model creation and tool instantiation
- **Strategy Pattern**: Pluggable AI runtime implementations

### System Relationships

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant UI as Chat Interface
    participant VM as View Model
    participant AR as AI Runtime
    participant ML as Model Loader
    participant DB as Database
    
    User->>UI: Send Message
    UI->>VM: sendMessage()
    VM->>AR: streamCompletion()
    AR->>ML: Load Model (if needed)
    ML-->>AR: Model Context
    AR->>AR: Generate Tokens
    AR-->>VM: Streaming Updates
    VM->>DB: Persist Message
    DB-->>VM: Confirmation
    VM-->>UI: Update Display
```

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

The application bootstraps through a carefully orchestrated initialization process:

**Root Layout Configuration** (`app/_layout.tsx`): Establishes the application shell with providers for navigation, gesture handling, keyboard management, and user preferences.

**Main Screen Routing** (`app/index.tsx`): Routes users to the primary chat interface, which serves as the central hub for AI interactions.

### Core Modules

**AI Runtime System** (`shared/ai/text-generation/runtime.ts`): Implements the core LLM inference engine using llama.rn, providing streaming generation, tool integration, and memory optimization features.

**Chat Management** (`features/chat/view-model/use-chat.ts`): Orchestrates conversation state, message handling, and AI interaction flows with comprehensive error handling and recovery mechanisms.

**Model Management** (`features/model-management/view-model/use-models.ts`): Handles model discovery, download, installation, and lifecycle management with progress tracking and validation.

**State Management** (`database/chat/index.ts`): Provides reactive state persistence using LegendAppState with MMKV backend for seamless offline functionality.

### Configuration Approach

**Build Configuration** (`app.json`): Comprehensive Expo configuration supporting multiple platforms, plugins, and build optimizations including Llama runtime integration and security features.

**TypeScript Configuration** (`tsconfig.json`): Strict type checking with path aliases and custom overrides for different file categories, ensuring code quality and maintainability.

**Testing Infrastructure** (`tests/setup.ts`): Jest-compatible test setup with React Native Testing Library configuration for comprehensive unit and integration testing.

### External Dependencies

The project leverages several key technologies:

- **React Native & Expo**: Cross-platform mobile development framework
- **LegendAppState**: Reactive state management with persistence capabilities  
- **Llama Runtime**: High-performance on-device AI inference engine
- **Whisper**: Real-time speech-to-text processing
- **TailwindCSS**: Utility-first styling framework
- **Zod**: Runtime type validation

### Integration Points

**Model Catalog Integration** (`shared/ai/text-generation/catalog.ts`): Extensive model catalog supporting multiple AI architectures including Llama, Qwen, Gemma, and Phi series with detailed hardware requirements.

**Tool System Integration** (`shared/ai/tools/registry.ts`): Pluggable tool execution framework enabling web search, URL fetching, and content parsing capabilities.

**Speech Processing Integration** (`shared/ai/stt/`): Multi-language speech recognition with Whisper models supporting Portuguese Brazilian dialects.

### Component Relationship Diagrams

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class ChatViewModel {
        +sendMessage()
        +initChat()
        +cancelGeneration()
        +toggleReasoning()
    }
    
    class AIRuntime {
        +loadModel()
        +unloadModel()
        +streamCompletion()
        +cancelGeneration()
    }
    
    class ConversationManager {
        +create()
        +addMessage()
        +getMessages()
        +getLastModelUsedId()
    }
    
    class ToolRegistry {
        +register()
        +execute()
        +getAll()
    }
    
    ChatViewModel --> AIRuntime
    ChatViewModel --> ConversationManager
    ChatViewModel --> ToolRegistry
    AIRuntime --> ToolRegistry
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Intelligent Chat Interface** (`features/chat/view/chat-screen.tsx`): Comprehensive chat experience with real-time message streaming, conversation history, and model switching capabilities.

**Advanced Model Management** (`features/model-management/`): Sophisticated model catalog with automatic detection, download progress tracking, and hardware compatibility verification.

**Multi-Modal Input/Output**: Seamless integration of text and voice interactions with customizable speech-to-text models for Portuguese Brazilian Portuguese.

**Privacy-Focused Architecture**: Complete data locality with encrypted storage, optional biometric authentication, and granular permission controls.

### Implementation Highlights

**Streaming Generation Engine** (`shared/ai/text-generation/runtime.ts`): Implements efficient token streaming with progressive rendering, memory optimization, and graceful degradation for resource-constrained devices.

**Reactive State Management** (`database/chat/index.ts`): Uses LegendAppState for reactive updates, automatic persistence, and cross-component synchronization without prop drilling.

**Hardware-Aware Model Loading** (`shared/ai/text-generation/runtime.ts`): Intelligent memory management with automatic model size adjustment and GPU acceleration detection.

**Comprehensive Testing Suite** (`tests/`): Extensive unit tests covering AI runtime functionality, model management, and UI components with property-based testing for edge cases.

### Feature Architecture Diagrams

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> LoadingModel: Select Model
    LoadingModel --> Ready: Load Success
    LoadingModel --> Error: Load Failed
    Ready --> Generating: Send Message
    Generating --> Streaming: Token Received
    Generating --> Error: Generation Failed
    Streaming --> Ready: Complete
    Streaming --> Cancelled: User Cancel
    Cancelled --> Ready: Reset
    Error --> Ready: Retry
    Ready --> Unloading: Switch Model
    Unloading --> LoadingModel: New Selection
```

**Performance Optimization Features**:
- Adaptive model sizing based on device RAM
- GPU acceleration when available
- Memory-efficient token streaming
- Background model warming for faster response times

**Extensibility Framework**:
- Plugin-based tool system for custom integrations
- Modular component architecture for easy feature addition
- Configurable model catalogs for different AI ecosystems
- Customizable UI theming and accessibility options

The application represents a mature, production-ready implementation of on-device AI capabilities, demonstrating best practices in mobile architecture while maintaining excellent user experience and performance characteristics.
